mintAuthority.summary: crvUSD retains economically unbounded arbitrary-recipient issuance through its immutable ControllerFactory. The complete pinned control census roots every unbounded mint, permission and upgrade path in Curve DAO Ownership Voting, which uses lock-escrowed veCRV and rejects execution until the 604800-second voting period ends. Agent, intermediary, Kernel, ACL and pinned EVMScript registry are separately modeled execution hops. The 5-of-9 emergency Safe has only reviewed restriction/parameter paths with bounded impairment, including callback/policy changes that preserve collateral and authenticated inventory-transfer checks.

controls.label: crvUSD ControllerFactory
controls.capDescription: The factory cannot raise its own admin-set recipient ceilings. Normal user borrowing through controllers is collateral-checked, but privileged set_debt_ceiling accepts an arbitrary recipient and mints increased inventory without a controller-registration or collateral check. DAO can raise these ceilings; they are not an immutable aggregate supply cap.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095803, crvUSD.minter() returned this factory and factory.admin() returned 0xb7400d2ea0f6dc1d7b153aa430b9e572f28afb79. Verified _set_debt_ceiling calls STABLECOIN.mint(addr, amount) on a ceiling increase without validating addr against registered controllers or requiring collateral. A read-only eth_call from the current DAO Agent through intermediary.execute(factory, set_debt_ceiling(0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD, 1e18)) succeeded at the pinned block; no transaction was sent. Token/factory verified direct-deployment source and zero proxy slots corroborate unchanged native logic, not a limit on governance-authorized issuance. D14/D29 review at block 26112822 (0x9a43012d71f59ade74c58a438ae4cf7eba960288f5357ddd8203d3a0ac51042a): verified source/bytecode match; every mint-reaching entrypoint is inventoried, including add_market, collect_fees_above_ceiling and public rug_debt_ceiling. Privileged arbitrary allocation/admin/blueprint changes trace to Ownership Voting -> Agent -> intermediary and require the 604800-second vote window. Public rug_debt_ceiling uses the already-set ceiling; it cannot increase debt_ceiling or choose a new authorized ceiling. Native factory/token are immutable; blueprint replacement affects future markets and is separately modeled as governance upgrade power.

controls.label: Curve DAO Agent execution contract
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095803, the factory-admin intermediary's dao() returned this Curve DAO Aragon Agent. The verified intermediary gates execute and factory-ownership transfer to DAO. Its arbitrary-call execution path can invoke factory set_debt_ceiling for an arbitrary recipient, not only a registered collateral controller; a pinned read-only simulation of this full path succeeded. The Agent's own governance execution prerequisites remain separately governed and were not simplified to a single-key signer. At block 26112822 (0x9a43012d71f59ade74c58a438ae4cf7eba960288f5357ddd8203d3a0ac51042a), implementation=0x3a93c17fc82cc33420d1809dda9fb715cc89dd37 and proxyType=2. Full ACL genesis-to-pin reconstruction has 67 events and no permission parameters: Ownership Voting is the only EXECUTE_ROLE holder and manager; SAFE_EXECUTE_ROLE/RUN_SCRIPT_ROLE are uncreated. Kernel APP_MANAGER_ROLE and ACL CREATE_PERMISSIONS_ROLE are held and managed only by this Agent. Proxy/implementation correspondence is pinned; upgrade, permission reactivation and script paths are explicitly included, not called immutable or absent.

controls.label: crvUSD factory-admin intermediary
controls.evidence: Verified direct-deployment Vyper source and pinned runtime match; dao() is Agent and emergency() is the reviewed Safe. Only dao may arbitrary execute, transfer factory admin or choose emergency; dao storage has no setter. Emergency parameter selectors are exact and retain downstream authentication, collateral and rate/fee limits; reduce_debt_ceiling explicitly requires amount<=current ceiling. No delegatecall, fallback or self-upgrade in the intermediary. Unbounded authority roots exclusively in the 604800-second Ownership Voting path; emergency restrictions are separately bounded.

controls.label: Curve DAO Aragon Kernel
controls.evidence: Pinned KernelProxy and Kernel implementation 0x2b33cf282f867a7ff693a66e11b0fcc5552e4425 bytecodes match verified source. Full ACL grants and permission managers put APP_MANAGER_ROLE only in Agent; no parameterized permissions exist. setApp includes core, app-base and app-address namespaces and can upgrade Agent/Voting/Kernel/ACL; all require the 604800-second Ownership Voting route. controls.label: Curve DAO Aragon ACL
controls.evidence: Pinned ACL proxy/implementation source correspondence and initialization block are reviewed. Full genesis-through-26112822 ACL history: 67 events, zero SetPermissionParams. Current CREATE_PERMISSIONS_ROLE and its manager are only Agent; Agent EXECUTE_ROLE holder/manager is only Ownership Voting; Kernel APP_MANAGER_ROLE holder/manager is only Agent. Role managers on Ownership Voting parameter powers are itself; the separate one-use vote-creation manager cannot execute votes or alter the execution window. Permission grants/revocations and mutable authorization targets are inventoried and require delayed governance; no wildcard execution permission or emergency mint/upgrading grant is present.

controls.label: Curve DAO pinned EVMScript registry
controls.evidence: Registry proxyType is pinned by verified AppProxyPinned source; implementation 0xbf1ce0bc4edaad8e576b3b55e19c4c15cf6999eb is bytecode matched. executorsNextIndex in slot0 is 2, so only id1 exists; id1 is enabled bytecode-matched CallsScript 0x5ceb19e1890f677c3676d5ecdf7c501eba01a054. CallsScript applies ordinary CALL and maintains script blacklist checks; the enclosing runner uses the fixed executor delegatecall and protects kernel/appId storage. Full ACL census shows registry admission and management roles ungranted with zero managers. Agent-controlled ACL may create them only through delayed Ownership Voting, modeled explicitly rather than declaring them finally disabled.

controls.label: crvUSD emergency multisig
controls.evidence: At block 26112822 (0x9a43012d71f59ade74c58a438ae4cf7eba960288f5357ddd8203d3a0ac51042a), Safe 1.3.0 singleton=0xd9db270c1b5e3bd161e8c8503c55ceabee709552; threshold=5, nine accounts; complete getModulesPaginated(0x1,100) returned no modules and next=0x1, guard slot is zero, fallback handler=0xf48f2b2d2a534e402487b3ee7c18c33aec0fe5e4. Source/runtime match for proxy, singleton and handler; fallback signature methods check Safe authorization and simulations always roll back. Modules, guards, fallback and delegatecall may be changed only through existing authorized Safe execution and cannot acquire intermediary DAO authorization. All nine Controller/LLAMMA pairs are bytecode matched: LM callback targets receive ordinary share-notification calls, no approvals/delegatecall; controller/AMM authenticated and nonreentrant loan/withdraw/swap paths retain collateral/input checks. Monetary policy returns are capped by MAX_RATE; compiled borrowing-discount and fee limits remain enforced. Emergency cannot change controller price oracles or factory admin/blueprints/fee receiver, invoke intermediary execute, raise debt ceilings or call collect_fees_above_ceiling. Four PegKeepers share Agent admin and regulator 0x36a04caffc681fa179558b2aaba30395cddd855f; emergency only changes regulator kill flags, not its oracle/fee/risk settings; update retains pool-balance, profitability and LP-claim accounting. YieldBasis emergency kill and forced withdrawal paths retain receiver==owner and burn that account shares, with debt settlement; FastBridge emergency only holds KILLER_ROLE. These are restriction/parameter-only capabilities with bounded impairment, not arbitrary issuance. The EIP-7702 account is explicitly recorded as custody identity, not inferred plain EOA.

governedIssuance.votingPowerEvidence: Pinned Ownership Voting.token() is veCRV 0x5f3b5dfeb7b28cdbd7faba78963ee202a494e2a2. Bytecode-matched VotingEscrow verified source requires CRV transferFrom into a time lock, rounds lock expiry by week, caps duration at four years and permits withdraw only after expiry. Voting uses totalSupplyAt/balanceOfAt for the block.number-1 snapshot; live transferable or flash-borrowed CRV cannot provide voting power. Current Voting implementation enforces voteTime=604800 before execution even after an absolute majority.

review.evidence: Re-reviewed at Ethereum block 26098749 on 2026-10-01. crvUSD.minter() identifies ControllerFactory 0xc9332fdcb1c491dcc683bae86fe3cb70360738bc; factory.admin() identifies intermediary 0xb7400d2ea0f6dc1d7b153aa430b9e572f28afb79; intermediary.dao() identifies Curve DAO Agent 0x40907540d8a6c65c637785e8f8b742ae6b0b9968. Verified factory set_debt_ceiling accepts an arbitrary recipient and increases minted inventory without controller-registration, collateral, or same-transaction repayment checks. A read-only eth_call from the current DAO Agent through intermediary.execute(factory, set_debt_ceiling(0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD, 1e18)) succeeded; the same call from the emergency address reverted with Only DAO. No transaction was sent. Emergency identity remains 0x467947ee34af926cf1dcac093870f613c96b1e0c, with five required signatures and nine owners; its verified reduce_debt_ceiling path cannot increase ceilings. Under owner ruling D14, the least-constrained durable DAO issuance path determines unbounded economic cap semantics; D29's separately certified governance closure yields the current unbounded-governed posture. No compromise is alleged. Numeric DAO-adjustable ceilings and normal collateral-checked borrowing do not bound this privileged path. Native immutability, prudential supervision, independent attestation, and emergency signer custody are not inferred from these reads. D14/D29 sweep on 2026-10-03 pinned to Ethereum block 26112822, hash 0x9a43012d71f59ade74c58a438ae4cf7eba960288f5357ddd8203d3a0ac51042a. D14 remains unbounded: set_debt_ceiling accepts an arbitrary recipient without collateral; the pinned DAO route simulation succeeded without sending a transaction. D29 now has complete execution certificates for Ownership Voting and seven authored execution/restriction controls, including Agent, intermediary, Kernel, ACL, EVMScript registry and emergency Safe. Full ACL grant/manager and script-executor censuses close authorization, upgrades and bypasses; no early-vote execution shortcut exists, and the minimum unavoidable unbounded-path delay is 604800 seconds. veCRV is lock-escrowed. Full 67 SetDebtCeiling-event reconstruction yields 31 historical recipients and 17 nonzero ceilings, all agreeing with pinned debt_ceiling reads. Emergency mutable callback/policy targets preserve guarded collateral/input checks across all nine bytecode-matched Controller/LLAMMA pairs; PegKeeper regulator rights are kill-only; YieldBasis forced withdrawal retains receiver==owner/share burn/debt settlement; FastBridge rights are kill-only. Safe module enumeration ends at sentinel, guard is zero, and the bytecode-matched compatibility fallback is explicitly certified. The delegated EIP-7702 account is custody identity only. Current derived-consistent posture is unbounded-governed. Token.set_minter is minter-only, and the factory verified complete entrypoint census contains no callable route to it; this does not constitute an independent native-upgrade or authorization bypass.
